name: ClickLinkOnWebPageNode
label: Click on Web Page
description: Simulates clicking a UI element (e.g., link, button) on a web page.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WebBrowserInstance
fields.label: Web Browser Instance
fields.description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

fields.name: FindType
fields.label: Find Type
fields.description: Specifies how to find the element (e.g., ID, XPath, CssSelector).

selectOptions.label: Relative
selectOptions.description: Find by relative position to another element

selectOptions.label: Automation Id
selectOptions.description: Find by element's automation ID (for WPF/UWP apps)

fields.name: ValueToFind
fields.label: Value To Find
fields.description: The selector used to locate the link or button on the web page.

fields.name: ClickType
fields.label: Click Type
fields.description: Specifies the type of click to perform.

selectOptions.label: Double Click
selectOptions.description: Double-click with the left mouse button.

fields.name: SendPhysicalClick
fields.label: Send Physical Click
fields.description: If true, simulates physical mouse movement before clicking.

fields.name: WaitForPageLoad
fields.label: Wait for Page Load
fields.description: If true, waits for the next page to load after the click.

fields.name: TimeoutForPageLoad
fields.label: Timeout for Page Load
fields.description: The maximum time (in seconds) to wait for the page to load.

fields.name: IfDialogAppears
fields.label: Handle Dialog
fields.description: Specifies what to do if a dialog appears after the click.

selectOptions.label: Close It
selectOptions.description: Automatically close any pop-up dialog that appears.

selectOptions.label: Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Press a specified button on the dialog.

selectOptions.label: Close It / Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Close or press a button on the dialog.

selectOptions.label: Accept Alert
selectOptions.description: Accept the alert dialog that appears.

selectOptions.label: Dismiss Alert
selectOptions.description: Dismiss the alert dialog that appears.

fields.name: DialogButtonToPress
fields.label: Dialog Button to Press
fields.description: The name of the button to press if a dialog appears (e.g., 'Ok', 'Cancel').

fields.name: MousePosition
fields.label: Mouse Position Relative to Element
fields.description: Specifies where to position the mouse relative to the element before clicking.

selectOptions.label: Top Left
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the top-left of the element.

selectOptions.label: Middle Left
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the middle-left of the element.

selectOptions.label: Bottom Left
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the bottom-left of the element.

selectOptions.label: Top Center
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the top-center of the element.

selectOptions.label: Middle Center
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse in the center of the element.

selectOptions.label: Bottom Center
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the bottom-center of the element.

selectOptions.label: Top Right
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the top-right of the element.

selectOptions.label: Middle Right
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the middle-right of the element.

selectOptions.label: Bottom Right
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the bottom-right of the element.

fields.name: OffsetX
fields.label: Offset X
fields.description: Move the mouse this many pixels horizontally from the selected position.

fields.name: OffsetY
fields.label: Offset Y
fields.description: Move the mouse this many pixels vertically from the selected position.
